info.title: API-DocTest-Replace Events Ticketing Tickets Transfer-v4-spec
info.description: The Transfer Tickets API facilitates the seamless transfer of event tickets between users within the ticketing platform. This operation allows ticket holders to reassign ownership of their purchased tickets or shares to another user, thus enhancing flexibility in ticket management. Ideal for event organizers, ticket sellers, and users looking to transfer their tickets for various reasons, this endpoint ensures that ticket ownership is accurately updated in real-time. By enabling easy ticket transfers, the API helps improve customer satisfaction and fosters greater use of the platform.

put.summary: Transfer a ticket to another user.
put.description: This endpoint allows you to transfer ownership of a ticket to another user. Provide the necessary details, including the ticket ID and the recipient's information, to complete the transfer.
